claims: NASA's Artemis II mission successfully launched on April 1, 2026.
Artemis II mission launched at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
Artemis II mission launched from Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
Artemis II launch site is Launch Complex 39B, Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
Artemis II rocket is Space Launch System (SLS).
Artemis II crew consists of Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
Artemis II crew consists of four astronauts.
Artemis II crew is currently on a 10-day mission to orbit the moon.
Artemis II is the first crewed lunar mission since 1972.
Artemis II mission goal is a 10-day crewed trip around the Moon.
SpaceX Crew-12 is scheduled to launch astronauts to the ISS.
Blue Origin New Glenn-3 is expected no earlier than Friday, April 10, 2026.
Starliner-1 is a future crewed private-sector flight.
